results.rationale: Consistency: The white backdrop and glossy floor remain consistent, but the untouched upright cup is visibly smaller and shifted left/down. Instruction: The left cup is moved closer and turned, but remains on the floor beside the upright cup; the expected result is that cup resting on top of the other, so the requested placement is absent. Quality: Coherent cup rims and interiors, smooth ceramic surfaces, and plausible floor contact and lighting; no noticeable artifacts.

Instruction: The sideways cup moves forward and right while still resting beside the upright cup; it should instead be placed onto the other cup, so the instruction is not fulfilled. Quality: Smooth ceramic surfaces and clear rims are present, but the steeply tilted upper cup has an implausibly precarious, poorly resolved support relationship at the lower rim, a noticeable structural/naturalness issue.
